WHAT A SHAME THAT IT MUST BE PURGED.
lines.zh: 真遗憾，它必须被清除。

lines.en: It’s tomorrow now.
lines.zh: 现在是明天了。

lines.en: Well, I guess it’s never really tomorrow.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想「明天」其实从来就不曾真正到来。

lines.en: But it’s a day different from the last.
lines.zh: 但这是与昨天不同的一天。

lines.en: I’m waking up in a different bed.
lines.zh: 我在一张不同的床上醒来。

lines.en: I’m feeling sunlight bleed in through different windows.
lines.zh: 我感到阳光从不同的窗户渗进来。

lines.en: There are different shadows on the floor. Different background noises and different foreground scenery.
lines.zh: 地板上有不同的阴影。不同的背景噪音，不同的前景风景。

lines.en: But I’m no different than I was just twelve hours ago.
lines.zh: 可我与十二小时前毫无不同。

lines.en: Even if I made another terrible mistake — carved another terrible gash into one of my terrible limbs that I can gaze at on the long walk home while thinking something vague like “why?” or “how?”
lines.zh: 即便我又犯下了一个可怕的错误——在我这具可怖的肢体上又划开一道可怖的伤口，好在漫长的归途中凝视着它，脑子里想着「为什么？」或者「怎么会？」之类含糊的东西。

lines.en: But what’s even more terrible than that metaphorical gash is that I already have an answer to both of those questions.
lines.zh: 但比那道隐喻的伤口更可怕的是，这两个问题我早就有了答案。

lines.en: I have told you I am weak.
lines.zh: 我告诉过你，我很软弱。

lines.en: I have told you I am scared.
lines.zh: 我告诉过你，我很害怕。

lines.en: And I’m sure you’re far too tired by now to hear me repeat those same self-loathing belittlements time and time again.
lines.zh: 而我相信，你此刻早已厌倦了一遍又一遍听我重复那些自我厌恶的贬低。

lines.en: This happened because there is a gap in my heart.
lines.zh: 这一切之所以发生，是因为我的心里有一道缺口。

lines.en: There’s a space that someone left a long time ago that only one person has been able to fill, and I’ve become so desperate that I can’t help but shove anything half-resembling her shape inside me now that she’s gone.
lines.zh: 很久以前有人留下的那个空位，只有一个人填得满。而如今她走了，我已经绝望到，忍不住要把任何有几分像她形状的东西往自己身体里塞。

lines.en: Yesterday, I found someone who looks a lot like her.
lines.zh: 昨天，我找到了一个很像她的人。

lines.en: Her voice is the same.
lines.zh: 她的声音是一样的。

lines.en: Her scent is the same.
lines.zh: 她的气味是一样的。

lines.en: The way I tower over her yet feel so much smaller is the same.
lines.zh: 我高她一头，却又觉得自己渺小得多——这种感觉也是一样的。

lines.en: But of course, she’s not a perfect fit.
lines.zh: 但当然，她并不是完美的契合。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar2
If she was-
lines.zh: 如果她是——

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar3
She wouldn’t look like this.
lines.zh: 她就不会是现在这副样子。

lines.en: If she was, I’d have no need to block her out again — and the two of us could ride off into the sunset as the worst, most-unsuited lovers you could ever imagine.
lines.zh: 如果她是，我就没有必要再次把她挡在外面——而我们两个本可以策马奔向夕阳，成为你能想象到的最糟糕、最不相配的一对恋人。

lines.en: But instead we’re here.
lines.zh: 可我们偏偏走到了这一步。

lines.en: It’s not tomorrow.
lines.zh: 这不是明天。

lines.en: It’s never really tomorrow.
lines.zh: 「明天」从来就不曾真正到来。

lines.en: But that just means I have a brand new chance to forgo romantic complacency and drown forever inside of the abyss that is never understanding how to make something fit when it’s not supposed to.
lines.zh: 但这只意味着，我有了全新的机会去舍弃情感上的将就，永远沉溺在那片深渊里——那深渊就是，永远学不会如何把一件本就不该契合的东西硬塞进去。

lines.en: Because I know other people do.
lines.zh: 因为我知道别人做得到。

lines.en: I know other people settle.
lines.zh: 我知道别人会凑合。

lines.en: But I know the feeling of finding something perfect. And I know the feeling of losing it even more.
lines.zh: 但我知道找到完美之物的感觉。而失去它的感觉，我懂得更深。

lines.en: And that’s why I can not stand for less.
lines.zh: 所以我无法忍受退而求其次。

lines.en: scene black
That’s why I’ll aim for tomorrow again.
lines.zh: 所以我才会再次把目标定在明天。

lines.en: One night was all I needed.
lines.zh: 我需要的，不过是一夜。

lines.en: And this doesn’t mean I’ll let her go.
lines.zh: 而这并不意味着我会放手。

lines.en: I don’t know if I ever can.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己是否做得到。

lines.en: But I didn’t have a dream last night.
lines.zh: 但昨晚我没有做梦。

lines.en: And I’m not sure if that’s good or bad.
lines.zh: 而我不确定这是好事还是坏事。

lines.en: You get dressed and leave the house again.
lines.zh: 你穿好衣服，又一次离开了这栋房子。

lines.en: You make another mistake.
lines.zh: 你又犯了一个错误。

lines.en: Why can’t you just stay still?
lines.zh: 你为什么就不能安分一点？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar4
: Mmmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯！

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar5
: Hah...
Something stirs.
lines.zh: 有什么东西动了动。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar6
She scans the room for the man she fell asleep beside, but all she finds are different shadows and a different foreground.
lines.zh: 她扫视房间，寻找那个她枕边入眠的男人，可找到的只有不同的阴影和不同的前景。

lines.en: : That fucking asshole just left me here on my own, didn’t he?
lines.zh: : 那个混蛋就这么把我一个人丢在这里了，是吧？

lines.en: scene black
She gets herself out of the unfamiliar bed.
lines.zh: 她从那张陌生的床上爬起来。

lines.en: It wasn’t the first time something like this had happened.
lines.zh: 这种事并不是第一次发生。

lines.en: He used to let her sleep after long nights as she had trouble getting up in the morning after them.
lines.zh: 在漫长的夜晚过后，他过去总是让她继续睡——因为那样的夜晚之后，她早上很难起得来。

lines.en: But this time was different.
lines.zh: 但这一次不一样。

lines.en: This time, she thought that maybe he’d have slept in with her.
lines.zh: 这一次，她以为他或许会陪她一起睡到很晚。

lines.en: This place, unfamiliar as it may be, could have been their castle.
lines.zh: 这个地方，尽管陌生，本可以成为他们的城堡。

lines.en: It didn’t have to stay unfamiliar for long. But now she feared that it would- and that she’d have to search for him all over.
lines.zh: 它本不必陌生太久。可如今她害怕它会一直陌生下去——也害怕自己不得不四处寻找他。

lines.en: For how long would she be willing to do that?
lines.zh: 她愿意为此找多久？

lines.en: You know the answer, of course.
lines.zh: 答案你当然知道。

lines.en: But she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 可她不知道。

lines.en: So it’s like everything is brand new.
lines.zh: 于是一切都像是全新的。

lines.en: Everything is scary again.
lines.zh: 一切又变得可怕起来。

lines.en: scene sky
She dresses herself in the same clothes she wore yesterday as the house she stayed in had never welcomed her before.
lines.zh: 她穿上昨天穿过的那身衣服，因为她借宿的这栋房子从未真正接纳过她。

lines.en: There was no trace of her anywhere. But now, there would be.
lines.zh: 这屋里原本没有她的任何痕迹。但现在，会有了。

lines.en: Now, her scent would be on his sheets. Her hair would be on his pillows. And he’d have to think of her.
lines.zh: 如今，她的气味会留在他的床单上。她的头发会留在他的枕头上。而他就不得不想起她。

lines.en: It was precisely what she wanted.
lines.zh: 这正是她想要的。

lines.en: However-
lines.zh: 然而——

lines.en: : ...Maya?
lines.zh: : ……Maya？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar7
She was not the only one who wanted something like this.
lines.zh: 想要这种事的，并非只有她一个人。

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : What are you doing all the way over here?
lines.zh: : 你跑这么远到这里来干什么？

lines.en: : What...are you doing all the way over here?
lines.zh: : 你……跑这么远到这里来干什么？

lines.en: : I asked you first.
lines.zh: : 是我先问的。

lines.en: : I...am just...going for a morning walk. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我……只是……出来晨间散步。就这样。

lines.en: : Then why are you wearing your uniform?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么穿着校服？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar8
: Well, you see...
lines.zh: : 呃，你听我说……

lines.en: : You don’t have a friend who lives over here, do you? Because I didn’t realize other people had started moving in yet.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是有朋友住在这一带吧？因为我还没听说已经有人搬进来了。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar9
: You...live here?
lines.zh: : 你……住在这里？

lines.en: : Yeah! With my little sister. And sometimes Yumi, but she’s been mostly staying at my old place since it’s closer to her job.
lines.zh: : 对啊！和我妹妹一起住。Yumi 有时候也住这儿，不过她最近基本都待在我以前那个家，因为离她上班的地方更近。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar10
: Wait! You’re not thinking of moving in too, are you?!
lines.zh: : 等等！你该不会也打算搬进来吧？！

lines.en: : What? Me? But I’ve already got...the dorm and...you know...
lines.zh: : 什么？我？可我已经有……宿舍了，而且……你知道的……

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar11
: Hey, you don’t have to be all shy and stuff! I think it’d be totally great if you lived here. I’m not trying to gate-keep it or anything. The more, the merrier.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不用这么害羞啦！我觉得你要是住这儿肯定特别好。我又不是要搞什么独占。人越多越热闹嘛。

lines.en: : Plus, if you were looking at apartments, it would totally explain why you left the Dorm Wars early yesterday and forced us into an 8 vs 10 match-up where we also lost a point due to your absence.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果你是在看房子，那就完全能解释你昨天为什么早早离开宿舍战争，害我们打成了 8 对 10，还因为你缺席被扣了一分。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar12
: Ah...yeah. That’s why I left. I had to look at this apartment. And I am...now finally finished looking at it roughly twenty-four hours later.
lines.zh: : 啊……对。我就是因为这个才走的。我得看看这套房子。而现在……在大约二十四个小时之后，我终于看完了。

lines.en: : It was a very thorough inspection.
lines.zh: : 这是一次非常彻底的勘察。

lines.en: : Well, whatever’s going on, I’m not gonna pry. I’m sure you’ve got your reasons.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管发生了什么，我都不会多打听。我相信你有你的理由。

lines.en: : What are your plans for the rest of the day, though? Still intent on going for a walk? Cause, if that’s the case, why not come with me to work? I could use the company since my boyfriend’s busy today.
lines.zh: : 不过你今天接下来有什么打算？还是要去散步吗？要是那样的话，不如跟我一起去上班？我男朋友今天忙，正好想有人作伴。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar13
: Boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 男朋友？

lines.en: : Some older guy. You don’t know him.
lines.zh: : 一个年纪比较大的男人。你不认识的。

lines.en: : Either way, I don’t really feel like going to the mall. So-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我不太想去商场。所以——

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar14
: Oh, I’m not at the mall anymore. I work at the maid cafe with Uta now. And Ami when she’s not busy being a psychopath.
lines.zh: : 哦，我早就不在商场了。我现在和 Uta 一起在女仆咖啡厅上班。Ami 也来，在她没忙着发神经的时候。

lines.en: : The maid cafe? So-
lines.zh: : 女仆咖啡厅？所以——

lines.en: : So I can get you a discount on food, yeah.
lines.zh: : 所以我可以给你打个餐点折扣，对。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar15
: Ahem...I suppose the rest of my walk can wait, then.
lines.zh: : 咳咳……那么我想，剩下的散步可以改天再说了。

lines.en: scene black
: Woo! Chika and Maya, new best friends going on an adventure across town!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！Chika 和 Maya，新晋挚友，开启一场穿越小镇的大冒险！

lines.en: : Does being your “best” friend increase the discount I receive? Because I will settle for “standard” friends if it does not.
lines.zh: : 成为你的「挚友」会让我拿到的折扣更高吗？如果不会的话，我做「普通」朋友也行。

lines.en: : I’ll have to ask Uta.
lines.zh: : 这个我得问问 Uta。

lines.en: scene sky
: I’m pretty sure she’s busy right now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺确定她现在正忙着呢。

lines.en: : Attention, everyone!
lines.zh: : 大家注意了！

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar16

: Thank you for coming all the way back here for this year’s Dorm Wars closing ceremony. And thank you even more for putting up with my rapid descent into madness as I crumble beneath the weight of the world!
lines.zh: : 感谢各位专程回到这里，参加今年的宿舍战争闭幕式。更感谢各位容忍我在世界重压下崩溃时，那急速滑向疯狂的过程！

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time. Pretty soon, you’ll be dressing like me and verbally expressing your wish to be fully crushed by said weight.
lines.zh: : 这只是时间问题。很快，你们就会穿得跟我一样，并且亲口表达希望被那份重量彻底压碎的愿望。

lines.en: : And thank you all for doing more for my mental health than Wakana has lately!
lines.zh: : 还要感谢各位，为我的心理健康所做的比 Wakana 最近做的多得多！

lines.en: : You should bang the taco man.
lines.zh: : 你应该去跟那个卖墨西哥卷饼的男人上床。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar17
: Rika as well.
lines.zh: : Rika 也是。

lines.en: : Why are you wearing that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么穿成这样？

lines.en: : I went for a morning jog along the track. I do that every day.
lines.zh: : 我沿着跑道晨跑去了。我每天都跑。

lines.en: : You do that...willingly?
lines.zh: : 你……是自愿的？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s a surprisingly good way to pick up girls and Rin deserves a third mom.
lines.zh: : 对啊。这招搭讪女孩子的效果好得惊人，而且 Rin 也该有第三个妈妈了。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar18
: I guess that explains why Nodoka is in her gym clothes as well.
lines.zh: : 看来这就是 Nodoka 也穿着运动服的原因了。

lines.en: : No matter how many times I apply for the job as Rin’s third mother, I’ve yet to receive so much as a call back.
lines.zh: : 不管我应聘 Rin 第三任妈妈多少次，连个回电都没收到过。

lines.en: : Rika, as a friend, I’d like to advise you that attempting to pick up women at your workplace is bad enough, but it takes on a new level of bad when your workplace is also a high school.
lines.zh: : Rika，作为朋友，我得提醒你：在工作场所搭讪女人已经够糟了，而当你的工作场所同时还是一所高中时，那就更上一层楼的糟。

lines.en: : You’re probably right. And that also explains why that girl who hits on you all the time keeps hitting on me as well.
lines.zh: : 你大概是对的。这也能解释为什么那个老是勾搭你的女生，现在也老是来勾搭我。

lines.en: : I think they’re talking about you, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她们说的是你啊，Nodoka。

lines.en: : Leave me be, Otoha. I do not fail very often. But when I do, it hurts just the same as it does for anyone else.
lines.zh: : 别管我，Otoha。我很少失手。可一旦失手，痛起来跟其他人没什么两样。

lines.en: : Does it really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar19
: I didn’t realize you had feelings as you’ve yet to actually apologize for all of those things you wrote about me in your book.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你还有感情这种东西——毕竟你至今都没为你在书里写我的那些事道过歉。

lines.en: : Would you have Picasso apologize for turning so many people into cubes? Or Tarantino for turning so many screenplays into unwatchable trash?
lines.zh: : 那你要不要让毕加索为把那么多人画成方块而道歉？或者让塔伦蒂诺为把那么多剧本变成没法看的垃圾而道歉？

lines.en: : No. But if either of those artists decided to air out their best friend’s sex life to thousands of people, I would. Right, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 不用。但如果这两位艺术家中有谁决定把自己最好朋友的性生活抖给成千上万的人听，我会要他道歉。对吧，Otoha？

lines.en: : Hey, don’t get me wrapped up in this. I’ve done a damn good job of remaining neutral at basically everything so far.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别把我扯进去。到目前为止，我在几乎所有事情上都保持了中立，而且做得相当好。

lines.en: : Are you still that upset with me over the book? I haven’t touched it in months.
lines.zh: : 你还在为那本书生我的气吗？我好几个月都没碰过它了。

lines.en: : No, I’m fine. Just saying.
lines.zh: : 没有，我没事。随便说说而已。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene endofnosenseiwar20

lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Soooo...
lines.zh: : 那那那……

lines.en: : So, what are we allowed to discuss and what are we not allowed to discuss about what happened last night? Because I need hard limits or I’m going to wind up telling everyone.
lines.zh: : 所以，昨晚发生的事，哪些能说、哪些不能说？因为我需要明确的界限，不然我迟早会跟所有人说出去。

lines.en: : I’ve already deleted the save file. As far as I’m concerned, nothing ever happened last night and no one ever watched me pleasure myself with a rubber tentacle. Game over.
lines.zh: : 我已经把存档删了。对我来说，昨晚什么都没发生过，也没有人看过我用橡胶触手自慰。游戏结束。

lines.en: : And...I definitely...never said anything that...you know...
lines.zh: : 而且……我绝对……没有说过什么……你知道的……

lines.en: : Sana, I think that if anyone permanently changed their image last night, it was you.
lines.zh: : Sana，我觉得要说昨晚有人彻底改变了形象，那个人就是你。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not sure if I can unhear that fantasy of yours. That was hot as fuck.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我不知道自己还能不能把那个幻想从脑子里清掉。简直他妈的太带感了。

lines.en: if makotonodowin == True:
: Rape fantasies are one thing. But taking the entirety of a fourteen inch dildo inside of you without a struggle? That’s a feat to remember.
lines.zh: : 强奸幻想是一回事。可把一根十四英寸的假阳具整根吞下去还面不改色？这可是值得铭记的壮举。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re kind of a freak, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 对。你有点变态啊，Makoto。

lines.en: : That was...actually...kind of cool...
lines.zh: : 那个……其实……还挺酷的……

lines.en: : I definitely like you more now. That’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 我现在肯定比以前更喜欢你了。这点毫无疑问。

lines.en: : And to think that all this time, all I needed to do to gain the affection of others was to visibly penetrate myself with a sex toy.
lines.zh: : 想想看，原来我一直以来要赢得别人的好感，只要当众用性玩具把自己捅穿就行了。

lines.en: : Hey, all I’m saying is it’s a lot easier to be a Makoto fan when you’re stuffing yourself with a fake dick than it is when you’re throwing worksheets at us.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我的意思是，当你往自己身体里塞假鸡巴的时候，要当 Makoto 的粉丝可比你朝我们扔卷子的时候容易多了。

lines.en: : You know what’s even hotter than rape fantasies, though? The fact that we’re all better friends now.
lines.zh: : 不过你们知道有什么比强奸幻想更带感吗？那就是我们现在都成了更好的朋友。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar21
: What?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Between this and the pony thing, I think most of us are starting to believe you just have some very...unusual fetishes, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 这件事加上小马那件事，我觉得大家多半开始相信，你身上有些非常……不寻常的癖好，Noriko。

lines.en: : Oh, come on! I didn’t mean it’s like, actually arousing.
lines.zh: : 拜托！我又不是说它那个，真的让我兴奋。

lines.en: : I’m just glad we all made some really intense memories that we can’t ever talk to anyone outside of the group about since we signed a legally binding document.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴我们一起创造了一些非常强烈的回忆，而且因为签了具有法律约束力的文件，这些回忆永远不能跟外人提起。

lines.en: : You say that as if you didn’t have the easiest job out of literally everyone.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像你的活儿不是所有人里最轻松的一样。

lines.en: : In my defense, Sana’s job was just as easy as mine. It is not my fault that she decided to take things a step further.
lines.zh: : 替我说句公道话，Sana 的活儿跟我一样轻松。她决定更进一步，那可不是我的错。

lines.en: : I still think...you did a really great job...
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得……你做得非常棒……

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar22
: I just...think I did a little better...
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得我做得更好一点……

lines.en: scene sky
: God! Since when are you such a little freak?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你什么时候变成这么个小变态了？！

lines.en: : Heheh...just remember that...I was only there...because Rin made me go...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……别忘了……我之所以会去……是因为 Rin 让我去的……

lines.en: : New Sana scares me.
lines.zh: : 全新的 Sana 让我害怕。

lines.en: : The chains have been released...
lines.zh: : 锁链已经解开……

lines.en: : Only the gods can stop Zagull now.
lines.zh: : 如今只有众神才能阻止 Zagull 了。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar23
: Considering that about a quarter of the class isn’t here right now, I’ll try to keep things short and sweet.
lines.zh: : 考虑到现在大约有四分之一的同学没到场，我尽量长话短说。

lines.en: : The final score of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB is 5 to 5.
lines.zh: : SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 的最终比分是 5 比 5。

lines.en: : However, as previously stated in the Dorm Wars preamble, one point will be deducted from the floor hosting any girl apart from Ami that does not participate.
lines.zh: : 不过，正如宿舍战争前言中所声明的，除 Ami 之外，任何未参赛的女生所属的楼层将被扣一分。

lines.en: : Surprisingly enough, we only have one girl who fits that bill and it’s Maya Makinami. Who, fittingly, is not here now either.
lines.zh: : 说来也巧，符合这一条的只有一个人，那就是 Maya Makinami。而她也恰如其分地同样不在场。

lines.en: : As such, the score becomes 5 to 4 in favor of the second floor, who can now call themselves the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB champions! Hooray and go team!
lines.zh: : 因此，比分变为 5 比 4，二楼胜出，她们现在可以自称 SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 的冠军了！万岁，加油！

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar24
: But of course, unless your name is Makoto, winning was never really the goal of this year’s Dorm Wars. The true goal was learning to work as a team.
lines.zh: : 不过当然，除非你叫 Makoto，否则获胜从来都不是今年宿舍战争的真正目的。真正的目标是学会团队合作。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar25
: But the true-er goal was just taking a load off of your backs and your minds for a little while.
lines.zh: : 但更真正的目的，不过是让你们肩上与心头的重担暂时卸下来一会儿。

lines.en: : I remember what it’s like to be a teenager. I was one of them not all that long ago, you know. Like, I’m still mad young. And youthful! And relatable! Right?!
lines.zh: : 我还记得当青少年是什么感觉。要知道，我不久前也还是个青少年呢。就是说，我还超年轻的！而且很有活力！很能理解你们！对吧？！

lines.en: : Just get on with it, Imani.
lines.zh: : 赶紧说重点吧，Imani。

lines.en: : Point is, I know things have been tough lately. And I know that stress is probably getting to you now more than it ever has before. But life’s still meant to be enjoyed at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 重点是，我知道最近日子不好过。我也知道，压力此刻大概比以往任何时候都更让你们吃不消。但说到底，生活终究是用来享受的。

lines.en: : So, whether you’re swimming through a pool of baby alligators...or playing a game with a giant ball that could crush any of you at any given moment...always try to look on the bright side.
lines.zh: : 所以，无论你们是在一池子小鳄鱼里游泳……还是在玩一个随时可能把你们任何人碾碎的巨型球游戏……都要试着往好处看。

lines.en: : And, if you can’t — remember that you’ve got a whole class worth of girls who’d be happy to help you.
lines.zh: : 而如果你们做不到——请记住，你们有一整个班的女生，都乐意帮助你们。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar26
: Class dismissed!
lines.zh: : 解散！

lines.en: : As thrilled as I am to be on the winning side of this year’s contest despite two personal losses, I can’t help but wonder why Maya elected to not participate.
lines.zh: : 尽管我个人输了两场，但能站在今年比赛的获胜方，我还是很激动——只是我忍不住想知道，Maya 为什么选择不参加。

lines.en: : Maya...is going through some shit right now. So, if it seems like she’s been acting weird lately, that’s probably the cause.
lines.zh: : Maya……最近正在经历一些事。所以，如果你觉得她最近举止怪怪的，大概就是这个原因。

lines.en: : Strange. She’s seemed mostly normal to me apart from her disappearance yesterday. But I suppose I don’t know her nearly half as well as you do.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。除了昨天失踪之外，她在我看来基本还算正常。不过我想，我对她的了解连你的一半都不到。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar27
: How’s Yasu, by the way? Is she feeling any better?
lines.zh: : 对了，Yasu 怎么样了？她好点了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yes. In fact, she was back to her normal self just this morning — pacing up and down the hall, screaming about “horrible changes that have yet to take root” or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 哦，是的。事实上，就在今天早上她就恢复常态了——在走廊里来来回回地踱步，大喊着什么「尚未生根的可怕变化」之类的话。

lines.en: : Oh, is that what that noise was? I kind of figured Molly was just playing some kind of game again.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来那阵动静是这么回事？我还以为 Molly 又在玩什么游戏呢。

lines.en: : Not quite. Molly didn’t return home until rather late. I wound up having to wake her up just so she wouldn’t miss the closing ceremony.
lines.zh: : 不太对。Molly 回来得很晚。最后还是我把她叫醒的，好让她不至于错过闭幕式。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo was nowhere to be found, though. But I assume she’s likely just at work.
lines.zh: : 不过 Tsuneyo 倒是哪儿都找不到。但我想她大概只是去上班了。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar28
: And how’s Io doing, Uta?
lines.zh: : 那 Io 怎么样了，Uta？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar29
: ...How’s Io doing, Uta?
lines.zh: : ……Io 怎么样了，Uta？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar30
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？

lines.en: : Have you no shame?
lines.zh: : 你就不觉得害臊吗？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar31
: None at all. I lost that a loooooong time ago. Sorry, Touka.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。那东西我很久很久以前就丢光了。抱歉啊，Touka。

lines.en: : Io. How is she? Is she still...upset about Nodoka’s comment?
lines.zh: : Io。她怎么样？她还在……为 Nodoka 那句话生气吗？

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar32
: Did something happen between the two of them while I was with Yasu in the infirmary?
lines.zh: : 我陪 Yasu 在医务室的时候，她们两个之间发生了什么事吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I think it’s best if as few people as possible know what was actually said.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……我觉得知道她们到底说了什么的人越少越好。

lines.en: : Io’s pissed. But she has stuff she can take to, like...turn her brain off when she has to. Me on the other hand? I’m fucking livid.
lines.zh: : Io 很生气。但她有能让自己……在必要的时候把脑子关掉的东西。而我呢？我他妈的气炸了。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar33
: Oh my. It must have been terrible if it’s gotten you to speak in such a manner. You’re typically so kind and polite. When you’re not undressing me with your eyes, of course.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。能让你说出这种话，那一定很糟糕。你平时是那么温柔有礼。当然，在你不用眼神剥我衣服的时候。

lines.en: : I don’t care how much Nodoka thinks she knows. Io was right when she said she’ll never get it. She doesn’t have the faintest fucking clue what that girl has gone through.
lines.zh: : 我才不管 Nodoka 自以为懂多少。Io 说她永远不会明白，她说得对。她他妈的根本不知道那个女孩经历过什么。

lines.en: : I can’t even look at her right now. And I want to forget it even happened, but...I’m not sure if I can.
lines.zh: : 我现在连看都不想看她。我多希望这一切从未发生过，可是……我不确定自己做不做得到。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar34
: Listen — I know Io’s not perfect. She’s not even close.
lines.zh: : 听着——我知道 Io 并不完美。她差得远了。

lines.en: : She’s toxic and mean and just...genuinely unlikable. But she’s only like that because of everything she’s had to deal with to get here.
lines.zh: : 她有毒，又刻薄，而且……真的讨人厌。可她之所以变成这样，全是因为她走到今天所经历的一切。

lines.en: : So I’m sorry if it ever seems like she’s doing all of that just to distance herself. Which...she is. But it’s for her own safety and-
lines.zh: : 所以如果她看起来像是在故意疏远大家，我很抱歉。虽然……她确实是在疏远。但那是为了保护她自己，而且——

lines.en: : You don’t have to apologize, Uta. It doesn’t matter what we think of Io. I’m sure we’re all in agreement that Nodoka’s comment crossed a line that no one thought was okay.
lines.zh: : 你不必道歉，Uta。我们怎么看待 Io 并不重要。我相信大家一致认为，Nodoka 那句话越过了所有人都无法接受的底线。

lines.en: : I just wanted to know if she was doing okay. That’s all. And, if she’s not, if there’s anything I can do to help.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道她还好吗。仅此而已。如果她不好，有没有什么我能帮上忙的。

lines.en: : I’m still mostly in the dark here, but I’d like to lend my assistance as well if such a thing is warranted.
lines.zh: : 我基本上还蒙在鼓里，但如果确有必要，我也很愿意出一分力。

lines.en: scene endofnosenseiwar35
: It’s fine, guys. She’ll be okay. I just...
lines.zh: : 没事的，各位。她会好起来的。我只是……

lines.en: : I hate that this happened.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌发生这样的事。

lines.en: scene sky
: We’ve all got secrets that could kill us if they get out.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都有见光就会要命的秘密。

lines.en: : Like, there are parts of me that I’m afraid of you all knowing as well...
lines.zh: : 比如说，我身上也有害怕被你们知道的部分……

lines.en: : But to have them revealed by someone who doesn’t even understand the context? Who can just...casually blurt them out like they’re things that just happen?
lines.zh: : 可要是被一个根本不了解前因后果的人揭出来呢？那个人还能……随随便便就当它们是家常便饭一样脱口而出？

lines.en: : That makes me want to puke.
lines.zh: : 这让我恶心到想吐。

lines.en: : I try to stay happy. I try to stay optimistic. I try to do so many things and, half of the time, I don’t even know who I’m doing them for.
lines.zh: : 我努力保持快乐。我努力保持乐观。我努力去做很多事，而有一半的时间，我甚至不知道自己是为了谁在做。

lines.en: : But I do them because that’s all I can do. That’s all we can do. Just...try. Just try, try, try and fucking fail and lose and cry because no matter how positive we try to be, bad things are still going to happen.
lines.zh: : 可我还是做了，因为那是我唯一能做的。那是我们所有人唯一能做的。就是……去尝试。去尝试、尝试、再尝试，然后他妈的失败、失去、哭泣——因为不管我们多努力保持积极，坏事依然会发生。

lines.en: : And that terrible past will never go away no matter how much we wish it would.
lines.zh: : 而那段可怕的过去，无论我们多么希望它消失，都永远不会离去。

lines.en: : I just want her to be happy.
lines.zh: : 我只希望她能幸福。

lines.en: : I want all of us to be happy.
lines.zh: : 我希望我们所有人都能幸福。

lines.en: scene black
: But sometimes, that just feels like a dream.
lines.zh: : 可有时候，那感觉就像一场梦。

lines.en: : And sometimes, I wonder if I’ll ever really feel happy again.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我会怀疑自己是否还能真正地快乐起来。

scene bedroom_day
I walk into my room to find more familiar sunlight bleeding in through a more familiar window.
lines.zh: 我走进自己的房间，看见更加熟悉的阳光，从更加熟悉的窗户渗进来。

lines.en: What do I want to do with my day?
lines.zh: 我今天想做点什么？
